terra.problem: The psalm calls the earth to praise God; it does not say nobody sings about themselves.
The joke mentions snacks, which breaks the food rule.
The psalm says the enemies cower; it does not say they are not gathering anything.
Papa Dorin says he walks and steps on a crumb, but he moves with his gold base and never steps off it.
The reference to a different story about water turning to blood needs a Scripture reference.
The psalm says they rejoiced there, not that they rejoiced in the middle of the crossing or that nobody waited.
The psalm does not say the rejoicing happened during the walk.
The warning not to let the rebellious exalt themselves does not say they are already doing so.
The verse does not say whether the crying out and praising happened on separate days.
The verse does not say the crying out and praising happened in the same breath.
